svg.title: The cardinal movements of labor
svg.desc: Six panels illustrating the sequence of fetal positional changes during labor in sagittal cross-section: engagement at the pelvic inlet, descent with flexion, internal rotation to occiput-anterior, extension as the head emerges, external rotation aligning the head with the shoulders, and expulsion of the body. In each panel the symphysis pubis sits at the front (left), the curved sacrum at the back (right). A small dot marks the fetal occiput so its rotation can be tracked across stages.
